headline: Shanghai AI Lab has released small open models that answer questions with a choice and a probability, rather than writing text, and reports they edge out a commercial rival.
score_reason: Interesting open release, but dated 28 Sep 2026 and based on the lab's own test results.
importance_line: Developers building agents and filters may get cheaper, more auditable decision tools, but the accuracy figures are the lab's own and the release is over a week old.
summary: Pandaily reports that Shanghai AI Lab has open-sourced Intern-Decision, a family of small models (0.8 to 4 billion parameters, the adjustable settings a model learns) that return a structured choice, score or yes/no answer with probabilities instead of text. The lab says its 4B model averages 90.02% on seven tests against 88.74% for a commercial rival, figures the report says are self-reported; Pandaily dates the release to 28 Sep 2026.
notes: Page text read from the article data embedded in the Pandaily page. Release dated 28 Sep, so stale; score lowered 5 to 4.
